display.purpose: Hero and section headlines, and every large standalone number (rates, stats, estimator output).

body.purpose: All running copy, nav, form labels, table cells.

label.purpose: Section kickers and small uppercase tags, colored Confident Teal.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus and panels that open over content (language menu, search panel, mobile menu).

shadows.name: floating-card
shadows.purpose: The home calculator card, lifted off the hero.

shadows.name: drawn-card
shadows.purpose: CSS-drawn credit card faces at default size.

shadows.name: drawn-card-stage
shadows.purpose: The drawn credit card at hero/stage scale on card-details pages.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Tip tile hover only; no shadow at rest.

shadows.name: segment-indicator
shadows.purpose: The active segment inside a tab/filter pill control.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Soft teal glow on focused search and form fields, paired with a border color change.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The only motion in the system: small state-change transitions. Disabled entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5em; font: 600 1rem/1 var(--body); color: var(--ink); background: var(--primary); text-decoration: none; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; padding: .95em 1.5em; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5em; font: 600 1rem/1 var(--body); color: var(--fg); background: transparent; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; padding: .95em 1.5em; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--tile); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Segmented Tab Control
components.description: Tab/filter track used by the calculator tabs and the credit-card filters.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; background: var(--tile); padding: 5px; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-seg-btn { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 600 .95rem var(--body); padding: .65em 1.1em; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; } .ds-seg-btn[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--card); color: var(--fg); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.12); } .ds-seg-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Toggle Pill
components.description: Selectable pill used for application-form step pickers (time at address, card filters).
components.css: .ds-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 16px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; min-height: 44px; } .ds-pill:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--mint); } .ds-pill input { accent-color: var(--primary); margin: 0; }

components.name: Tonal Tile
components.description: The default flat container for grouped content (offers, product tiles, stat tiles).
components.css: .ds-tile { background: var(--tile); border-radius: 32px; padding: 28px; display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-tile strong { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 88%; font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-tile span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; }

components.name: Bordered Card
components.description: A lifted white card used inside tonal sections (tip tiles, document links).
components.html: Budget plannerPlan around the cost of living.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 24px; background: var(--card); color: var(--fg); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -22px rgba(2,40,44,.5); } .ds-card span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Standard text field with focus and invalid states.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: .92rem; } .ds-field input { font: 500 1rem var(--body); color: var(--fg); background: var(--card); border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 14px; min-height: 48px; width: 100%; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(2,97,105,.18); } .ds-field input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--err); background: var(--err-bg); }

components.name: Drawn Credit Card
components.description: Signature CSS-only credit card face at a 1.586 aspect ratio.
components.css: .ds-ccard { aspect-ratio: 1.586; width: 320px; border-radius: 18px; padding: 20px 22px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; position: relative; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 22px 44px -22px rgba(2,40,44,.55); font-family: var(--body); background: var(--primary); color: #fff; } .ds-ccard::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 70%; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; right: -22%; top: -40%; border: 28px solid currentColor; opacity: .08; } .ds-ccard-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-ccard-brand { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 95%; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-ccard-chip { width: 42px; height: 32px; border-radius: 7px; background: #d9c58b; } .ds-ccard-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: end; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-ccard-num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .14em; font-size: .82rem; opacity: .8; } .ds-ccard-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: .9rem; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Current Nav Link
components.description: Header nav link in its current-page state.
components.html: Credit cardsLoans
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); padding: .55em .9em; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--tile); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current] { background: var(--mint); }

narrative.overview: SecurBank's visual system is calm, confident forward motion, not stillness. It takes its cue from the hero's own line, "Sail into financial independence": one saturated teal runs through the whole site like current under a boat, surfacing in buttons, links, focus rings, and the feature surfaces that carry the most important choice on a page. Everything else sits on flat, tinted panels so that current reads clearly against a quiet background, and numbers (rates, repayments, limits) are the one place the system slows down and gets exact: tabular, aligned, impossible to misread. This system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS-cream fintech look, a cream/off-white background with a single muted-blue accent and a uniform grid of rounded cards, and it equally rejects the dated, bureaucratic high-street bank look of dense navy tables and serif headers. SecurBank is fictitious, but the system is built to feel like a real, self-assured challenger bank: bold uppercase display type for the moments that matter, restrained body type everywhere else, and no decoration that doesn't carry a role.
keyCharacteristics: One confident accent (teal), used deliberately rather than scattered
Pill shapes everywhere a control is clickable: buttons, tabs, filters, chips, tags
Flat tonal panels by default; shadows reserved for a short list of floating elements
Heavy uppercase Archivo for headlines and big numbers; Inter for everything you read
Tabular numerals wherever a number changes, compares, or lines up in a column

rules.name: The One Current Rule
rules.body: Confident Teal is the only saturated accent in the system. When a second accent color is needed, reach for Bright Teal Accent (a lighter tint of the same hue) before introducing a new hue.

rules.name: The Flat-Tile Default Rule
rules.body: A section's background panel is Lavender-Grey Tile or Soft Mint Tint, never a bordered white card, unless that panel is meant to read as something sitting on top of the page.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes, compares, or lines up in a column (calculator results, rate chips, comparison tables, the estimator, application result figures) is set with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. No exceptions.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Means-Weight Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + Archivo is reserved for headlines and hero numbers. Uppercase in Inter (labels, eyebrows, card names) stays small and letter-spaced; it never substitutes for the display treatment.

rules.name: The Floating-Element Rule
rules.body: If it's not an overlay, a drawn card, the home calculator, or responding to hover/focus, it doesn't get a shadow. Flat panels stay flat.

dos: Do keep every clickable control pill-shaped (border-radius: 999px): buttons, tabs, filters, toggle pills, tags.
Do set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on any number that changes, compares, or lines up (rates, calculator results, tables, estimator output, application result figures).
Do keep Confident Teal (#026169 light / #4fb8c0 dark) as the only saturated accent, reaching for Bright Teal Accent (#8fd6db) rather than a new hue when a second value is needed.
Do keep shadows limited to the Shadow Vocabulary's short list, overlays, the home calculator, drawn cards, and hover/focus states, and leave every other flat tile and band shadowless.
Do maintain 44px minimum touch targets and the 3px Confident Teal :focus-visible outline with 3px offset on every interactive element.
Do keep the fictitious-bank statement on every page, per PRODUCT.md.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right as a colored accent stripe on any card, tile, or callout.
Don't default to the generic SaaS-cream fintech look, a cream/off-white background, a single muted-blue accent, and a uniform grid of identical rounded cards, per PRODUCT.md's anti-reference.
Don't swing to the opposite failure mode either: dense navy tables, serif headers, or clip-art icons that read as a dated, bureaucratic bank site.
Don't add real regulator registration numbers, deposit-protection badges, or similar marks. SecurBank is fictitious; those marks would be misleading, per PRODUCT.md.
Don't invert dark mode mechanically. Follow the project's actual remapped dark palette (Confident Teal lightens to #4fb8c0, the band darkens to #06292c) rather than a CSS filter or flat color-swap.
Don't drop the paired error treatment (Alert Red border + Alert Red Tint fill + aria-invalid) when adding new form fields.
